case.summary: Case HHG-013, opened on 2016-12-09, involved transaction 3526826 for $35.66 on card C07671-K2, flagged due to a bank risk score of 0.76. Evidence showed the online purchase was from a new device but the transaction amount was well within the card's 95th percentile for online purchases. A separate classifier scored the transaction at 0.01, indicating low fraud probability. Based on these signals, the transaction was allowed and the case closed as legitimate, consistent with Policy 6 which permits closing cases when activity is consistent with history and fraud probability is low on independent signals. No further action or report is recommended.
